changelog: - **Re-entering a value that did not change no longer resets the run.** When a node or connection setting was set again to the value it already had, the run was reset and the diagram was saved as if something had changed; on a connection this happened even though Undo no longer showed a step for it. Now a setting that ends up exactly as it was changes nothing: the run keeps its place, no Undo step is added and nothing is saved.
